audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Nautilus Level 1, Level 6 and 2+ items, contradicting the packet chart, the 41.94% win rate and its own whys (which call 1 even, 6 a wash and late a hard loss).
audit.why: At 1 neither side has an all-in; at 6 Final Hour's Tumble invisibility answers Depth Charge; at 2 items Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage ignores the tank stats Nautilus buys.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 4-5 Skill, Level 6 Skill, First item Vayne, 2+ items Vayne.

audit.why: Spikes cover levels 2-3, level 6, her first zeal/Botrk item and 2 items — matching where the duel actually flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither the Tumble auto-attack-reset tell nor the fact that Condemn only stuns into terrain is stated anywhere.
audit.why: Tumble (Q, 6/5/4/3/2s) is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the burst tell, not the cast; Condemn (E, 20/18/16/14/12s) knocks back and only stuns if you hit terrain — fighting in open lane removes the stun entirely.
audit.corrected: State the Tumble reset tell and the open-lane rule against Condemn.

edits.before: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even at 1 — no W or E means no all-in, and her Tumble auto-reset punishes any auto you throw inside her range.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Depth Charge always starts the all-in, but Final Hour's Tumble invisibility breaks your follow-up — a wash unless Condemn is already down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in and Silver Bolts' true damage ignores everything you built — Vayne carry threat 9.5/10, so play peel, not duels.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — hug open ground, engage while it is down.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-HP true damage — HP stacking feeds it, buy armour.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Condemn stuns only into terrain — fight in open lane, not against the wall.

edits.before: Hook Vayne as his answer goes down, passive-root, W-shield the return, E-slow the retreat — the chain does the rest.
edits.after: Hook Vayne the instant Tumble is spent, passive-root, W-shield her return, E-slow the kite — she has no second dash.

edits.before: Depth Charge is undodgeable lockdown, but she answers it with E condemn or Q tumble + invis — land R when her dashes are down, not on cooldown.
edits.after: Depth Charge is undodgeable lockdown, but Final Hour's Tumble invisibility breaks your follow-up — fire R when Tumble and Condemn are both down.

notes: Level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with its own whys at rows 0, 4, 5, 6; flipped as one paired group. Added the Tumble auto-reset tell and the terrain-only Condemn stun from missingInteractions.
